description: The plot titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” shows how the maximum activation value varies by transformer layer for four quantities, with the x-axis labeled “Layer” on a linear scale spanning roughly 0 to 23 and numeric ticks shown at regular 5-layer intervals (0, 5, 10, 15, 20), and the y-axis labeled “Max Activation Value” on a linear scale from 0 up to 400 with evenly spaced tick marks every 50 units. A blue dashed line labeled “attn_output” starts near 0 at layer 0, stays in the low single digits through roughly layers 5–12, rises to around 10–15 by about layers 14–16, fluctuates in the tens through about layers 18–22 (with a visible local high around the low-30s near layer ~20–21), and then increases sharply at the final layer to a bit above 100. An orange dotted line labeled “attn_residual” begins near 0, climbs gradually to around the mid-teens by about layer 4–5, continues increasing steadily into the tens by the mid layers (around ~30–50 by roughly layers 13–16), rises further to around ~100 by about layer 18–19, and then accelerates strongly in the last few layers, ending near the mid-200s at the final layer. A green dash-dot line labeled “ffn_output” starts near 0, remains close to 0–5 through roughly the first 10–12 layers, increases to around ~5–10 by the mid-teen layers, rises into the tens by about layers 19–22, and then shows a sharp end-of-range jump to roughly the mid-100s at the last layer. A red solid line labeled “ffn_residual” also starts near 0, increases to around the mid-teens by about layer 4–5, then grows steadily into the tens (around ~30–60 by the mid-teen layers), rises to around ~100 by about layer 18–19, and exhibits the largest late-layer surge, ending just below 400 (around the high-300s) at the final layer.
